title: TinkerPipeline State Map
description: Runner-owned pipeline state, keyed by project id. Written by the TinkerPipeline runner at each phase transition and read by the TinkerOps dashboard alongside registry.json. The registry itself is never modified by the runner.

phase.description: Current pipeline phase for this project

status.description: Outcome state of the most recent runner activity

last_run.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the most recent phase transition

last_task.description: ID of the last task the runner acted on

last_commit.description: Short hash of the last commit the runner produced

runner_version.description: TinkerPipeline runner version that wrote this state
